stories.title: Caergwrle Methodist Church solar panels approved against planning officers’ advice
stories.summary: A church in a Flintshire conservation area has been granted permission to install solar panel against officers recommendations. While not itself a listed building, Caergwrle Methodist Church is situated in the heart of the village’s conservation area. stories.title: North Wales 4G ‘not-spots’ targeted as £4.6m grant scheme opens to mobile firms
stories.summary: Mobile network operators have until 3 November to bid for a share of £4.6m to fill gaps in 4G and 5G coverage across North Wales. stories.title: Decision on £200m Parc Adfer carbon capture plant deferred as English villages not consulted
